length_limits.notes: Eight pages of main paper at submission and nine at camera-ready; references, the impact statement and appendices are unlimited. The submission PDF is capped at 50 MB and the camera-ready at 20 MB.

figure_spec.notes: Vector graphics are preferred for plots; bitmaps are permitted only for illustrations that cannot be vectorised. The size cap is the whole submission PDF, not one figure.

reference_style.style: Not stated; the guidance is about content, replacing arXiv citations with peer-reviewed versions and fixing bibliographic capitalisation.

submission_steps: abstracts were due 23 January 2026 and full papers 28 January 2026, anywhere on Earth
add a lay summary and a conflict-of-interest paragraph at camera-ready
accepted papers publish through PMLR under its publication agreement

template.notes: A style-file zip downloads without a login. Linked, never stored.

license_of_summary_source.statement: No copyright or licence statement appears on the page; it links a privacy policy and a code of conduct.
